purpose: Human reference annotations for semantic evaluation. Replace each null specific_theme_ids with the complete list of supported leaf IDs; use an empty list for a correct abstention.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Application and decisions > Application requirements
theme_reference.definition: The documents, business history, and information required to apply.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Application and decisions > Decision turnaround
theme_reference.definition: The time between submitting an application and receiving an approval or rejection.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Application and decisions > Decision transparency
theme_reference.definition: How clearly an application status, outcome, and reasons for the decision are communicated.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Funding and invoices > Payout timing
theme_reference.definition: The elapsed time between invoice approval or submission and payout.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Funding and invoices > Invoice administration
theme_reference.definition: Creating, changing, automating, or otherwise managing invoices in the financing service.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Product fit and flexibility > Product suitability
theme_reference.definition: How well a financing or banking product fits the company's size, situation, and needs.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Product fit and flexibility > Credit line flexibility
theme_reference.definition: The ability to adjust, renew, or end a credit line without unnecessary reapplication or delay.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Repayment and collections > Repayment flexibility
theme_reference.definition: The availability of adapted repayment plans, payment deferrals, or seasonal arrangements.

theme_reference.path: Financing lifecycle > Repayment and collections > Collections handling
theme_reference.definition: How the company communicates and acts before or during debt collection.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Fees > Fee level
theme_reference.definition: The overall amount or cumulative burden of fees charged.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Fees > Fee transparency
theme_reference.definition: How clearly individual fees, their purpose, and their inclusion in an offer are disclosed.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Interest rates > Interest rate level
theme_reference.definition: The competitiveness or affordability of the interest rate offered.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Interest rates > Interest calculation
theme_reference.definition: How clearly and accurately interest or effective rates are calculated and explained.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Interest rates > Rate change communication
theme_reference.definition: How interest-rate changes are announced and reflected in the product.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Contractual terms > Terms clarity
theme_reference.definition: How easy the agreement, eligibility rules, and product conditions are to find and understand.

theme_reference.path: Pricing and terms > Contractual terms > Term changes
theme_reference.definition: Changes to agreed product conditions and how those changes affect the customer.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Support delivery > Response timeliness
theme_reference.definition: How quickly and reliably support responds across phone, email, chat, or messaging.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Support delivery > Follow-up and ownership
theme_reference.definition: Whether staff take responsibility, keep promises, and follow an issue through to completion.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Support delivery > Support channel navigation
theme_reference.definition: The ability to reach the right help, move beyond automated support, and avoid channel loops.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Advisor relationship > Advisor expertise
theme_reference.definition: The advisor's knowledge of products, rules, and the customer's business situation.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Advisor relationship > Staff conduct
theme_reference.definition: How courteous, respectful, and constructive staff are when dealing with customers.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Advisor relationship > Relationship continuity
theme_reference.definition: The availability of a consistent contact person and continuity when staff change.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Information trust > Cross-channel consistency
theme_reference.definition: Whether the portal, website, chatbot, email, and staff provide compatible information.

theme_reference.path: Service and communication > Information trust > Institutional credibility
theme_reference.definition: Signals that affect trust in the company, including the perceived authenticity of public reviews.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Online portal > Portal access
theme_reference.definition: The ability to authenticate and log in to the portal reliably.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Online portal > Portal usability
theme_reference.definition: How clear, modern, and easy the portal is to navigate.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Online portal > Portal performance
theme_reference.definition: The speed, responsiveness, and technical stability of the portal.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Mobile banking > Mobile app
theme_reference.definition: The availability and practical functionality of the mobile application.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > External integrations > Accounting integration reliability
theme_reference.definition: How consistently and accurately accounting-system integrations exchange data.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Reporting and data > Reporting and export access
theme_reference.definition: The availability, history, completeness, and exportability of statements and reports.

theme_reference.path: Digital experience and data > Reporting and data > Financial data accuracy
theme_reference.definition: The correctness of balances, transactions, invoices, and other financial figures displayed.

annotations.content_en: We have recommended them to four other companies in the industry.

reference.notes: Endorsement only; no subject discussed.

annotations.content_en: Sent the case to collections over 900 kroner without calling first.
Payout the same hour the invoice was approved.
The portal is the best I have used in a bank. Full stop.

reference.notes: General portal praise; usability is the closest leaf.

annotations.title: Får ikke svar på et enkelt spørsmål
annotations.content_en: I have asked three times what the establishment fee actually covers. Nobody can answer. The chatbot sends me in circles and the email goes unanswered.

reference.notes: Unexplained establishment fee, chatbot loop, unanswered email.
Emoji only.

annotations.title: Gebyrer overalt
annotations.content_en: Fee to open, fee to change, fee to close. In the end the fees ate up the entire saving.
Is the interest rate floating or fixed? Nothing about it is stated in the agreement I received.

reference.notes: Missing floating/fixed statement in the agreement; arguably also interest_calculation.

annotations.content_en: The portal said "approved", the email said "rejected". Which one should I believe?

reference.notes: Portal and email contradict on the application outcome.

annotations.content_en: Always calls back when they say they will.
Credit-checked me four times in two weeks. That hits my score.

reference.notes: Repeated credit checks harming credit score; no leaf covers credit enquiries (known coverage gap).

annotations.title: God opplevelse
annotations.content_en: Good experience from start to finish.

reference.notes: Pure sentiment.

annotations.content_en: Switched from a big bank last year. Faster, friendlier, cheaper. No regrets.

reference.notes: 'Friendlier' supports staff_conduct; 'faster' and 'cheaper' too unspecific to pin to a leaf.

annotations.content_en: The price quoted on the phone was not the price in the agreement. Two percentage points higher.

reference.notes: Phone quote incompatible with the agreement; arguably also interest_calculation.

annotations.content_en: Okay bank for short-term needs. Wouldn't use them for anything long-term.
Tax loan approved in an hour in December. Saved the quarter.
The money was supposed to be in the account on Friday. It arrived the following Wednesday. By then I had already paid the supplier out of my own pocket.
Unprofessional from start to finish.

reference.notes: Pure sentiment; 'unprofessional' names no subject.

annotations.content_en: The invoice financing has saved our liquidity through a hard winter. No longer having to wait 60 days for customers to pay.

reference.notes: Invoice financing fits their liquidity need; 60-day wait refers to their customers, not Kvist payouts.

annotations.content_en: We are a sole proprietorship and evidently don't qualify. Fine, but it says nothing about that anywhere.

reference.notes: Eligibility rules (sole proprietorship) not disclosed anywhere.

annotations.content_en: Good follow-up throughout the application. Docking a little for a slow system.

reference.notes: 'Slow system' read as the digital system.

annotations.content_en: The direct debit takes the right amount on the right day, every month.

reference.notes: Direct debit takes correct amount; nearest leaf is transaction correctness, though definition says 'displayed'.

annotations.title: Skjønte hva vi trengte
annotations.content_en: The advisor understood our business model immediately and suggested an overdraft facility instead of the loan we had applied for. That was the right advice.

reference.notes: Advisor knowledge plus recommending the better-fitting product.

annotations.content_en: The app exists but can't do anything other than show the balance.

annotations.title: Advarsel til andre gründere
annotations.content_en: We started in 2024 and needed liquidity. The advert promised financing for start-ups. After two weeks and four rounds of documents we were rejected on the grounds of "too short a track record". They could have said that in the form on day one. We lost three weeks and a supplier agreement.

reference.notes: Four document rounds, two weeks, eligibility (track record) not disclosed upfront; decision_transparency defensible too.

annotations.content_en: Happy customer since 2021.

reference.notes: Pure sentiment.

annotations.title: Truende inkassopraksis
annotations.content_en: Was two days late with one instalment. Got a collections notice and a reminder fee of 350 kroner before anyone had even called. When I asked for a payment plan I was told it wasn't possible.

reference.notes: Collections notice before contact; payment plan refused. The 350 kr reminder fee arguably also fee_level.

annotations.content_en: Quite a lot of documentation, but they explained why they needed each piece.

annotations.title: Ikke som annonsert
annotations.content_en: There is no 3.9% interest rate. The effective rate turned out to be 38% per year when I read the terms properly.

reference.notes: Advertised nominal vs 38% effective rate; terms_clarity is a defensible secondary.

annotations.title: Bra men dyrt
annotations.content_en: Fast and simple application, but compared to our local bank they are expensive. You pay for the speed.

reference.notes: 'Fast and simple application'; 'expensive' too unspecific to pick fee vs rate leaf.

annotations.content_en: Finally a bank where I don't have to meet anyone in person to sign.

reference.notes: Digital signing without in-person meeting; no matching leaf. Borderline application_requirements.

annotations.content_en: Closed the account. Got an invoice two months later.

reference.notes: Invoice issued after account closure treated as incorrect invoice; account administration is a coverage gap.

annotations.content_en: Tried to close in January. It is now April.

reference.notes: Account closure delayed for months; 'end without delay' is the nearest leaf.

annotations.content_en: Absolutely splendid to sit in a phone queue for 55 minutes to be told they can't help.

reference.notes: Sarcastic five-star; 55-minute queue. 'Told they can't help' could also support support_channel_navigation.

annotations.content_en: No fees, clear price, fast help. Nothing more to say.

reference.notes: 'No fees', 'clear price', 'fast help'.

annotations.content_en: It works, but nothing more than that.

reference.notes: Pure sentiment.

annotations.content_en: No way to give the accountant access. Have to send everything manually.

reference.notes: Cannot grant accountant access; user-role management is a known coverage gap.

annotations.content_en: Never again.

reference.notes: Pure sentiment.

annotations.content_en: They changed the repayment plan three times without blinking when our project was postponed.

annotations.title: Dyrt
annotations.content_en: Paying almost 19% effective. That is a lot for a company with a good track record.
They called and sold me a product I didn't need. Classic.

reference.notes: Sold a product they did not need; unsolicited sales calls are a coverage gap.

annotations.title: Delte erfaringer
annotations.content_en: The product itself is good and the money came quickly. But when I needed help with an incorrectly posted invoice it took nine days before anyone replied, and then I got two different answers from two different people.

reference.notes: Good product, fast money, wrongly posted invoice, nine-day wait, two conflicting answers.

annotations.content_en: The nicest bank people I have spoken to. No sales patter.
Your reply below is not correct. We never received the email they claim to have sent, and the support case is still open.

reference.notes: Disputed company reply, unreceived email, case still open.

annotations.content_en: The maximum loan amount is too low for a company of our size.
A bit expensive, but they deliver on what they promise.

reference.notes: 'A bit expensive' too unspecific to pick fee vs rate leaf; 'deliver on promise' is generic praise.

annotations.content_en: The invoice overview shows the wrong due date. Have reported it three times.

reference.notes: Wrong due date displayed; reported three times without resolution.

annotations.content_en: They changed our terms and informed us afterwards. That is not an agreement, it is a dictate.
They called and asked if we needed help when they saw the instalment was late. No other bank has done that.

reference.notes: Proactive call about a late instalment: communication before collection, positive polarity.

annotations.title: Fra skeptisk til fan
annotations.content_en: I was sceptical about a digital bank with no branch. But the application took minutes, the money arrived the same day, and when I needed to speak to someone I got a person on the line who actually knew our case. The rate is higher than the big bank, but we save so much time that it doesn't matter.

reference.notes: Minutes-long application, same-day money, knowledgeable contact, higher rate than the big bank.
